parts.text: This question is about sea water and the substances found in sea water.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Table 2.1 shows the masses of the compounds formed when 1000 cm 3 of sea water is evaporated. Table 2.1 compound formula mass of compound / g sodium chloride NaCl 14.0 magnesium sulfate MgSO 4 3.0 potassium chloride KCl 1.0 CaCO 3 1.0 Answer these questions, using the information from Table 2.1.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The total mass of compounds formed from 1000 cm 3 of sea water is 19.0 g. Calculate the total mass of compounds formed from 1750 cm 3 of sea water. mass = .............................. g [1]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Magnesium sulfate is soluble in water. Choose one other compound that is soluble in water. Tick (3) one box. lead( II ) chloride magnesium carbonate potassium hydroxide silver chloride [1]

parts.text: (c) Sodium ions are in sea water. Complete Fig. 2.1 to show: • the electronic configuration of a sodium ion • the charge on the ion. Fig. 2.1 [2]
